facts.content: For viral URTI/ILI, recommend rest and oral fluids.
Use paracetamol as needed for fever and aches.
Consider delayed antibiotic prescription of Amoxicillin if no improvement or worsening in 24–48 hours.
facts.source_text: Delayed antibiotic rx: Amoxicillin 1 tab TID x5 days if no improvement or worsening in 24–48h (per discussion)

facts.content: Seek care if high fever, worsening SOB, chest pain, confusion, dehydration, or persistent symptoms over 7 days.
facts.source_text: Safety-net: seek care if high fever, worsening SOB, chest pain, confusion, dehydration, persistent symptoms >7 days

facts.content: Monitor shortness of breath; return if increasing breathlessness or new chest pain.
facts.source_text: Monitor symptoms; return if increasing breathlessness or new chest pain

facts.content: Continue metformin; maintain hydration; monitor glucose more frequently due to illness.
facts.source_text: Continue metformin; maintain hydration; monitor glucose more frequently during illness ("sick day" awareness)

facts.content: Continue lisinopril for hypertension.
Reinforce smoking cessation and continue vaping as a bridge with a goal to quit.

facts.content: Provide alcohol moderation counseling: aim for ≤14 units per week with several dry days.
